# SEC Filing Document Copilot

An enterprise-grade, pilot-ready AI copilot designed for financial research analysts to query SEC Form 10-K filings with **strict verbatim citation grounding**, **hybrid dense-sparse retrieval (Reciprocal Rank Fusion)**, and an **interactive Trust UI**.

Engineered and optimized to run **100% within free tiers ($0.00 infrastructure cost)**.

---

## Key Features

* **Strict Verbatim Grounding**: Every claim generated by the assistant is tied to a citation chip backed by an exact substring match from SEC 10-K passages. Hallucinations and unsourced numbers are rejected by a Python verification layer.
* **Hybrid Retrieval (RRF $k=60$)**: Combines 768-dimensional Gemini vector embeddings (`pgvector` with HNSW cosine indexing) and PostgreSQL `tsvector` full-text search fused using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
* **Optimized Free-Tier Pipeline**:
  * Local heuristic keyword extractor with financial stopword filtering (0 API calls).
  * In-memory `@lru_cache` query embedding layer.
  * Direct grounded single-turn synthesis (1 LLM call per question).
  * High-availability fallback routing when upstream AI servers report high traffic.
* **Interactive Trust UI**:
  * Verbatim citation chips with click-to-inspect drawers.
  * **Source Passage Inspector** with `±1 Chunk` context expander to read adjacent 10-K paragraphs.
  * Real-time pulsating pipeline status indicator during keyword extraction, retrieval, and synthesis.
* **Multi-Tenant Architecture**: Thread-isolated chat persistence with PostgreSQL and Supabase Authentication.

---

## Architecture Overview

```mermaid
graph TD
    User([Analyst Browser / UI]) -->|User Prompt| API[FastAPI Backend :8000]
    API -->|1. Extract Keywords| KW[Local Financial Heuristic (0 API calls)]
    API -->|2. Embed Query| EmbedCache[In-Memory Query Cache]
    EmbedCache -->|Cache Miss| GeminiEmbed[Google Gemini Embedding (768-dim)]
    API -->|3. Parallel Search| DB[(Supabase PostgreSQL)]
    DB -->|HNSW Vector Distance| DenseSearch[Dense Vector Search]
    DB -->|tsquery / tsvector| SparseSearch[Full-Text Search]
    DenseSearch & SparseSearch -->|Reciprocal Rank Fusion| RRF[Top RRF Candidate Passages]
    RRF -->|4. Passages + Prompt| LLM[Google Gemini 2.5 Flash]
    LLM -->|5. Structured Grounded Answer| Validator[Python Verbatim Quote Validator]
    Validator -->|Verified Citations + Text| Stream[SSE Streamer]
    Stream -->|Real-time Tokens & Status| User
```

## Quickstart: Running Locally

### Prerequisites

* **Python**: Version 3.12+ ([uv recommended](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/))
* **Node.js**: Version 18+ and `pnpm` (or `npm`)
* **Supabase**: Free Supabase project with `pgvector` extension enabled
* **Google Gemini API Key**: Free API key from [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/)

---

### Step 1: Configure Environment Variables

#### Backend (`backend/.env`)

Copy `backend/.env.example` to `backend/.env` and update the values:

```bash
cd backend
cp .env.example .env
```

```env
# --- Supabase (Auth + API) ---
SUPABASE_URL=https://<your-project-id>.supabase.co
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<your-supabase-anon-key>
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=<your-supabase-service-role-key>

# --- PostgreSQL Connection String ---
# Use session connection for migrations & pooled for app
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://postgres.<project-id>:<password>@aws-0-<region>.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres"

# --- Google Gemini API ---
GEMINI_API_KEY="<your-google-gemini-api-key>"
GEMINI_CHAT_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash
GEMINI_EMBEDDING_MODEL=gemini-embedding-001
GEMINI_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS=768

# --- Server CORS Origins (comma-separated) ---
ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:5174
```

#### Frontend (`frontend/.env`)

Copy `frontend/.env.example` to `frontend/.env` and configure the 3 required variables:

```bash
cd ../frontend
cp .env.example .env
```

```env
# Backend API Base URL
VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000

# Supabase Public Client Configuration
VITE_SUPABASE_URL=https://<your-project-id>.supabase.co
VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<your-supabase-anon-key>
```

---

### Step 2: Database Migration

Navigate to `backend` and apply the Alembic schema migrations:

```bash
cd backend
uv run alembic upgrade head
```

This creates tables for `users`, `chat_threads`, `chat_messages`, `source_documents`, `document_chunks` (with pgvector embedding column and HNSW index), and `message_citations`.

---

### Step 3: Launch the Backend

From the `backend` directory:

```bash
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
```

The FastAPI backend will start at `http://127.0.0.1:8000`.
* Interactive OpenAPI Swagger documentation: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs`
* Health check endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/health`

---

### Step 4: Launch the Frontend

From the `frontend` directory in a new terminal:

```bash
cd frontend
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Open your browser at `http://localhost:5173`. Create an account or log in with your Supabase credentials to begin querying filings.

## SEC Filing Ingestion Guide

The project includes an end-to-end ingestion pipeline to fetch raw SEC filings, transform them into structured Markdown, chunk them hierarchically, and index them in Supabase.

### 1. Download Filings from SEC EDGAR
```bash
uv run data/download.py
```
Downloads Form 10-K filings for tickers (`AAPL`, `MSFT`, `NVDA`, `AMZN`, `GOOGL`).

### 2. Convert to Clean Markdown
```bash
uv run data/convert_to_markdown.py
```
Uses Docling to clean SEC HTML/XML tables and text into high-fidelity Markdown files in `data/Markdown/`.

### 3. Chunk, Embed, and Ingest into Database
To parse, chunk, and embed a specific company filing:
```bash
# Run from repository root
uv run --directory backend python -m data.ingest.cli --ticker AAPL --year 2024 --write --embed --replace
```

Flags:
* `--ticker`: Stock symbol (`AAPL`, `MSFT`, `NVDA`, `AMZN`, `GOOGL`).
* `--year`: Filing fiscal year (e.g. `2024`, `2023`).
* `--chunk-limit`: Limit chunk count for quick testing (e.g. `--chunk-limit 50`).
* `--write`: Insert documents and chunks into Supabase PostgreSQL.
* `--embed`: Generate 768-dimensional Gemini vector embeddings for chunks.
* `--replace`: Overwrite existing chunks for this filing.

## Automated Verification & Smoke Tests

Run the verification suite from the `backend/` directory:

### 1. Unit Tests
```bash
cd backend
uv run pytest tests/ -v
```
Tests keyword extraction, FTS formatting, reciprocal rank fusion math, and strict verbatim citation validation.

### 2. Hybrid Retrieval Verification
```bash
uv run python scripts/smoke_retrieval.py
```
Tests end-to-end database retrieval (semantic vector search + tsvector full-text search fused with RRF) against actual filings.

### 3. End-to-End Grounded Assistant Smoke Test
```bash
uv run python scripts/smoke_assistant.py
```
Executes a live query through Gemini LLM reasoning, validates all generated quotes against source chunks, and prints verified citation cards.

### 4. Frontend Production Build Check
```bash
cd frontend
pnpm run build
```
Typechecks via `tsc -b` and bundles production assets via Vite.

## API Reference & Streaming Events

The chat orchestrator streams responses to the frontend using **Server-Sent Events (SSE)** via `POST /chat/threads/{thread_id}/messages`:

| SSE Event Type | Payload Structure | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `{"type": "status", "message": "..."}` | Real-time pipeline stage (keyword extraction, vector search, RRF fusion, synthesis). |
| `text-delta` | `{"type": "text-delta", "text": "..."}` | Streaming response token chunk. |
| `citations` | `{"type": "citations", "citations": [...]}` | Grounded citations containing chunk UUID, verbatim quote, document year, and full metadata. |
| `finish` | `{"type": "finish"}` | End of transmission. |
